rationale.conceptual: Standard periodic DFT with a well-known functional (PBE-D3) and open-source code, but the structure construction from AA-stacking and P3 symmetry, along with proper setup of SCF and band structure calculations, requires domain knowledge and meticulous implementation, fitting a level 3 (established non-trivial method needing careful implementation).
rationale.execution: The workflow involves multiple stages: structure generation, geometry relaxation, band structure extraction, and DOS projection, totaling 4-5 dependent steps. While all steps use the same Quantum ESPRESSO tool, the orchestration (input file creation, job submission, data parsing) is non-trivial, fitting a level 3 pipeline.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires constructing atomic models of two COFs from lattice parameters and molecular fragments, then performing periodic DFT calculations (geometry optimization, band structure, DOS) using Quantum ESPRESSO. The DFT methodology is standard (PBE-D3) but demands careful structure building, input preparation, and convergence. The pipeline has 4 sequential stages, all using the same tool, making execution moderately complex.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The COF unit cells are large (a ≈ 33–35 Å) with hundreds of atoms; plane-wave DFT calculations require substantial CPU memory (est. 64 GB) and many core-hours; no external datasets are loaded.
